room_description: A classic study with dark wood paneling, a floral sofa, a coffee table with a newspaper and tea set, and a kitchen counter area on the right.

key_moments.description: Opening the kitchen drawer to find a green hand pump.
Finding an orange combination box on the floor.
Lifting the sofa cushions to find a red/blue magnet.
Using the hand pump to inflate the deflated basketball.
Observing the color-coded star pattern on the inflated ball.
Using the magnet to fish a metal item out of the bean barrel.
Pouring a cup of coffee to reveal the code '7164'.
Solving the fruit-clicking puzzle to get the final key.

solution_steps: Retrieve the green pump from the kitchen drawer.
Use the pump on the flat basketball on the rug.
Identify the color sequence: Red, Yellow, Blue, White.
Find the magnet under the sofa pillow.
Use the magnet on the large wooden barrel filled with beans.
Pull out the small metal handle.
Interact with the coffee pot on the counter.
Pour the coffee into the empty white mug.
The bottom of the mug reveals the code '7164'.
Enter the code '7162' into the orange chest on the floor.
In the mini-game, click the fruits one by one to make them disappear until only the key remains.

final_action: The player takes the silver key from the fruit plate and uses it to unlock the center door and escape.
